convert_unet_to_kandinsky3: run the script to convert a U-Net safetensors model to Kandinsky3UNet format using --model_path and --output_path
convert_state_dict_function: call convert_state_dict to rename U-Net state dict keys to match Kandinsky3UNet expected key format
main_function_load_and_save: run main to load a safetensors model, convert its state dict, and save as a pretrained Kandinsky3UNet
review_mapping_dict: review the MAPPING dictionary that defines static key rename rules for U-Net to Kandinsky3UNet conversion
refactor_dynamic_map: refactor the DYNAMIC_MAP wildcard patterns to support additional resnet attention block key renaming rules
